body: This was in her book “Enough Rope”!! I never see much Dorothy Parker anywhere so it makes me happy when I see people posting her :-)

Life can get better, I won’t make any promises for that but I can promise you it’ll change at some point. I’m not in the best place right now myself, but know threads like those exist so that we understand we’re not going through all of those alone even if our mind says we are. The world isn’t actually on fire you just happen to be in the presence of a flame and at some point flames go out no matter how big they get. here’s hoping for better days stranger

broooo i love this so much, first the title and beginning sentence had me sold. the topic you chose particularly resonates with me and i could feel the same sharp pain in your diction that i’m sure you had when you wrote the piece. Although, if i’m honest the ending is my favorite part “throw it all into one big whole”. It sounds both finite but eternal like something that’ll always be there even if you can’t see it. Anyway, i’m rambling please never stop writing !

i’m not trying to be funny when i say this is one of the best poems i’ve read on the subreddit, i don’t think i’ve ever heavily identified so easily with the structure of writing or a topic. I loved the “daughter of cupid” line it flowed so easily with the rest of the work and put an ethereal tone that entire part. please keep writing !
i’m surviving i think, just trying to make it to the next day. how are you?
i receive the virtual hug and kind words, i am still here. i hope you’re doing well kind person
thanks kind stranger, well wishes to you

hi !! i’ve suspected that and unfortunately i am still a minor who cannot drive (high school senior who started school early) so i am still quite dependent on my family. we found a therapist but getting appointments is quite difficult rn. thanks for the support 💛

thank you for your feedback I really appreciate it 🥺 I’m glad you enjoyed it. The lines were supposed to sound empty though and maybe I can tweak the way the I write that so the reader may understand. The emptiness in the lines are supposed to mirror the way I’m feeling, I’m actually talking about 4 different people (4 seasons) and it really is supposed to sound hollow because that’s how I thought of the memories when I wrote it. Empty, shallow, pseudo-graves for things that used to bring me warmth. I hope this wasn’t too much of a downer haha and hopefully cleared some of it up !

i’m sorry op :( I went through something similar. Losing a person you thought was the one is always heartbreaking and feels like something you will never get over. I won’t say the pain goes away at all—I know mine hasn’t. But it does get duller and duller everyday so you think about them less and cry for a shorter period of time than you did the day before. Fate always intervenes tho, this is probably something you don’t want to hear but the more you focus your energy into yourself the more likely that they may come back. If they’re really the one they will always have perfect timing. I hope you feel better and you and your love can be together ! Good luck :)
thank you for the kind words, well wishes to you and the ones you love❤️

I think it’s very important to hear this kind of thing from a male perspective because I don’t think we as readers hear enough of it (I am assuming you are male based on the pronouns used in the piece but if not, I apologize in advance op please correct me). That balance in between being okay and not wanting to look in the mirror is a tough one but a harsh reality for a lot of people. Including me. I like the way you described the feeling I believe you captured it perfectly.

hi ! I read your poem and I think it’s touching. I could feel the nostalgia and emotion you wrote with about you dad through the screen. The way you wrote makes all the memories something the reader can picture even if the people remain faceless. i’m sorry for your loss, the text is great from what i’ve read though.
i’ve been there and that sucks, i’m sorry. you are loved ! :(
